narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Blue Overalls, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Blue Overalls! Thank goodness, I have a proper change of clothes.Take this, and please be on your way. I do not have time to chat, I must keep an eye on the farm and can't risk more distractions.
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh! Please keep your voice down, we don't need to draw any further attention to ourselves.Do you have something for me?

giverName: an item: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls
